column1: # Known pathogenic deep intronic alleles, reported on every run of step 06
# and CLINVAR_SCREEN with the sample's call at each one, carrier or not:
# clinvar/<sample>_clinvar_deep_intronic.tsv. These sit far from any exon, so
# exome-style filters and splice-site windows miss them, and a site with no
# call reads the same as a site with a reference call unless the gVCF says
# which (Vaz-Drago 2017, Hum Genet, PMID 28497172). Each row is a ClinVar
# Pathogenic record with an expert-panel or multi-submitter review.
